title: The Secret Scent of Rain
hook: Your nose can detect the smell of rain better than a shark.
script: Your nose can detect the smell of rain better than a shark. That fresh scent is called petrichor. It is delivered by tiny air bubbles that burst from the ground like champagne. The smell comes from a compound called geosmin, produced by soil bacteria. Could you smell this in a crowded city? Your nose detects geosmin at five parts per trillion. That is like sensing one teaspoon of a substance in twenty Olympic-sized swimming pools. This sensitivity is so high it can ruin the taste of bottled water. The smell of rain is actually the scent of bacteria.
